title: Asghar tera jhula
body:
Asghar tera jhula
Asghar tera jhula
<<DIVIDER>>
Veeran aagosh-e-madar
Veeran dil Sakina ka
Kahymo(n) ki tarha hai veeran
<<MINI>>
(Asghar tera jhula) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
Ansu bahaaye
Kaise jhulaye
Bali Sakina haay
<<MINI>>
(Asghar tera jhula) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Jalti zamee(n) par, tu soraha hai
(Furqat mei teri, dil roraha hai) x2
Roti hai madar
Roti hai khwaahar
Karta hai nawha haay
<<MINI>>
(Asghar tera jhula) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Suna hai jangal, suni hai godi
(Zakhm-e-judaayi, degaya tu bhi) x2
Veeran dil hai
Veeran khayma
Ye kehke roya haay
<<MINI>>
(Asghar tera jhula) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Aa mere jaani, aagaya pani
(Aja mita du, tashnadahani) x2
Kuza uthakar
Rowi Sakina
Jaise hi dekha haay
<<MINI>>
(Asghar tera jhula) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Tera humakna, yaad aaraha hai
(Madar ke dil ko, tarpa raha hai) x2
Thaam ke royi
Jhule ki dori
Khali jo laaya haay
<<MINI>>
(Asghar tera jhula) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Maqtal mei tujhko, kya neend ayi
(Kisne waha par, lori sunaayi) x2
Kal tak thi jhula
Aagosh-e-madar
Aaj ye sehra haay
<<MINI>>
(Asghar tera jhula) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Nazdeek jakar, jhule ke madar
(Kok jali ye, kehti hai rokar) x2
Jaawu kaha(n) mei
Saare jahaa(n) mei
Hai meri duniya haay
<<MINI>>
(Asghar tera jhula) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Ankho(n) mei dajna hai ansuwo(n) ka
(Lab pe bukaa hai, dil matami hai) x2
Hai aza khaana
Dil teri maa ka Aur isme beta haay
<<MINI>>
(Asghar tera jhula) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Maa ki fugha(n) ka, lori samajh kar
(Ay mere bache, aja palat kar) x2
Kethi hai madar
Hoti zabaa(n) gar
Tujhko bulaata haay
<<MINI>>
(Asghar tera jhula) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Baab-ul-hawaa'ij, ay maula Asghar
(Kehte hai sab se, Irfan-o-Mazhar) x2
Paayi duaaye(n)
Usme Ali se
Jisne uthaaya
<<MINI>>
(Asghar tera jhula) x4
